translationRepairs: From Yumen and Yang passes into the Western Regions there are two routes: from Shanshan along the southern mountains’ north, following the river west to Kashgar—this is the southern route; west of the southern route crossing Congling leads out to Great Yuezhi and Parthia.

From Yumen and Yang passes into the Western Regions there are two routes: from Shanshan along the southern mountains’ north, following the river west to Shache—this is the southern route; west of the southern route crossing Congling leads out to Great Yuezhi and Parthia.
莎車 is Shache (Yarkand), not Kashgar (疏勒 is Shule).
Han pushed farms to Beixujian and sliced into Kashgar—the colonel of garrison troops now answered to the Protector-General.
Han pushed farms to Beixujian and opened up the lands of Shache—the colonel of garrison troops now answered to the Protector-General.
莎車 is Shache (Yarkand), not Kashgar.
Thereupon shifted garrison-farm; farmed at Beixujian; opened Kashgar lands—garrison-farm colonel first subordinated to Protector-General.
Thereupon shifted garrison-farm; farmed at Beixujian; opened Shache lands—garrison-farm colonel first subordinated to Protector-General.
莎車 is Shache (Yarkand), not Kashgar.
Watchtowers ran from Dunhuang to Lop Nur; hundreds of farmers garrisoned Luntai and Karashahr under an Envoy-Colonel for outbound missions.
Watchtowers ran from Dunhuang to Lop Nur; hundreds of farmers garrisoned Luntai and Quli under an Envoy-Colonel for outbound missions.
渠犁 is Quli, not Karashahr (焉耆 Yanqi).

Thereupon from Dunhuang west to Salt Marsh watchtowers arose everywhere; moreover Yulongtai and Karashahr each had several hundred garrison-farm troops—Envoy-Colonel placed to lead protection—to supply those serving abroad.

Thereupon from Dunhuang west to Salt Marsh watchtowers arose everywhere; moreover Luntai and Quli each had several hundred garrison-farm troops—Envoy-Colonel placed to lead protection—to supply those serving abroad.
渠犁 is Quli, not Karashahr (焉耆 Yanqi). 輪台 is Luntai.
The headquarters sat at Wulei—2738 li west of Yangguan—near Karashahr’s farms in the Tarim’s fertile middle.
The headquarters sat at Wulei—2738 li west of Yangguan—near Quli’s farms in the Tarim’s fertile middle.
渠犁 is Quli, not Karashahr (焉耆 Yanqi).
Protector-General governed from Wulei city, 2738 li from Yang Pass, near Karashahr farm officials—land fertile—among Western Regions central—therefore Protector-General governs there.
Protector-General governed from Wulei city, 2738 li from Yang Pass, near Quli farm officials—land fertile—among Western Regions central—therefore Protector-General governs there.
渠犁 is Quli, not Karashahr (焉耆 Yanqi).

Afterward Cavalry-General smashed Xiongnu right territory, submitting Kings Huntun and Xiutu—thereupon emptying that land—first built west of Lingju, first placing Jiuquan commandery; afterward gradually mobilizing relocated commoners to fill it, divided placing Wuwei, Zhangye, Dunhuang—arraying four commanderies, holding two passes.

Afterward Cavalry-General smashed Xiongnu right territory, submitting Kings Hunye and Xiutu—thereupon emptying that land—first built west of Lingju, first placing Jiuquan commandery; afterward gradually mobilizing relocated commoners to fill it, divided placing Wuwei, Zhangye, Dunhuang—arraying four commanderies, holding two passes.
When eastern Pulei prince Zilizhi brought seventeen hundred followers in, the Protector-General carved Wuchen-zili pasture west of posterior Turfan for their settlement.
When eastern Pulei prince Zilizhi brought seventeen hundred followers in, the Protector-General carved Wutanzili pasture west of posterior Turfan for their settlement.

At this time Xiongnu eastern King of Pulei Zilizhi led a host more than seventeen hundred to surrender to Protector-General; Protector-General divided west of Jushi posterior king as Wuchen-zili lands to settle them.

At this time Xiongnu eastern King of Pulei Zilizhi led a host more than seventeen hundred to surrender to Protector-General; Protector-General divided west of Jushi posterior king as Wutanzili lands to settle them.
1785 li northwest of Wulei; 1365 to Karasahr’s mountains; 1890 northwest to Turfan.
1785 li northwest of Wulei; 1365 to the state of Moshan; 1890 northwest to Turfan.
墨山國 is Moshan state, not Karashahr's mountains.
Wu-di trusted Zhang Qian’s maps and craved the Ferghana road—caravans of envoys passed each other, a dozen missions some years.
Wu-di trusted Zhang Qian’s reports and craved the Ferghana road—caravans of envoys passed each other, a dozen missions some years.
言 = his words/reports; no maps in the source.
Colonel Ren Wen at Yumen captured prisoners and reported the plot.
Army Rectifier Ren Wen at Yumen captured prisoners and reported the plot.
軍正 is the army rectifier (military judge), not a colonel.
At the time Han Colonel Ren Wen commanded troops garrisoned Yumen Pass—as Ershi’s rear guard—captured living tongue—learned situation and reported upward.
At the time Han Army Rectifier Ren Wen commanded troops garrisoned Yumen Pass—as Ershi’s rear guard—captured living tongue—learned situation and reported upward.
軍正 is the army rectifier (military judge), not a colonel.
Zhenghe first year Loulan king died; countrymen came requesting crown prince in Han—wished to establish him.
Zhenghe first year Loulan king died; countrymen came requesting hostage prince in Han—wished to establish him.
質子 is a hostage prince, not the crown prince.
Crown prince had been condemned under Han law—sent to silkworm chamber for palace mutilation—therefore not dispatched.
The hostage prince had been condemned under Han law—sent to silkworm chamber for palace mutilation—therefore not dispatched.
質子 is a hostage prince, not the crown prince.
The kingdom of Yutian had its royal residence at the western capital, nine thousand six hundred seventy li from Chang'an.
The kingdom of Yutian had its royal residence at Western City, nine thousand six hundred seventy li from Chang'an.
西城 is the name of the royal city (Western City), not a 'western capital'.
The Han court assigned Colonel of the Pass Wen Zhong to escort the returning embassy.
The Han court assigned Commandant of the Pass Wen Zhong to escort the returning embassy.
關都尉 is Commandant of the Pass.
Han envoy Guanduwei Wen Zhong escorted their envoys.
Han envoy Pass Commandant Wen Zhong escorted their envoys.
關都尉 is an office (Commandant of the Pass), not part of a name.
Later the army guide Zhao De visited Jibin and quarreled with Yinmofu, who chained him, slaughtered more than seventy men down to the deputy envoy, then sent a letter of apology.
Later the army captain Zhao De visited Jibin and quarreled with Yinmofu, who chained him, slaughtered more than seventy men down to the deputy envoy, then sent a letter of apology.
軍候 is an army captain (company commander), not a guide.
Later army scout Zhao De was envoy to Jibin; with Yinmofu mutually fell out; Yinmofu shackled fetters bound De; killed deputy and below seventy-odd persons; sent envoys with memorial apologizing.
Later army captain Zhao De was envoy to Jibin; with Yinmofu mutually fell out; Yinmofu shackled fetters bound De; killed deputy and below seventy-odd persons; sent envoys with memorial apologizing.

Sixty days' march northeast of the Protector-General's seat, it bordered Jibin on the east, Puda on the north, and Roman Syria and Tiaozhi on the west.
Sixty days' march northeast of the Protector-General's seat, it bordered Jibin on the east, Pudiao on the north, and Roman Syria and Tiaozhi on the west.
Wugo's basin is torrid and flat; flora, fauna, grains, produce, diet, architecture, markets, coinage, arms, and gems match Jibin's, but it also yields taoba beasts, lions, and rhinoceroses.
Wuge's basin is torrid and flat; flora, fauna, grains, produce, diet, architecture, markets, coinage, arms, and gems match Jibin's, but it also yields taoba beasts, lions, and rhinoceroses.
Terrain, climate, products, and customs resemble those of Wugo and Jibin.
Terrain, climate, products, and customs resemble those of Wuge and Jibin.
一封橐駝 are one-humped camels; Bactrian camels have two humps.
